title: Salmon Salad with Zesty Vinaigrette
description: A refreshing salad featuring grilled salmon, mixed greens, and a tangy zesty dressing. Perfect for a light and healthy lunch.

ingredients.name: Mixed greens
ingredients.notes: Choose a variety of lettuce, arugula, and spinach

ingredients.name: Zesty dressing
ingredients.notes: Mix of lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon mustard, and chopped fresh herbs

instructions: Season salmon fillet with salt and pepper.
Grill salmon for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, red onion, cherry tomatoes, and chopped parsley.
In a small bowl, whisk together zesty dressing and French vinaigrette.
Drizzle dressing over salad and toss to combine.
Slice grilled salmon and place on top of salad.
